Pick up a facizer
Unstack a facizer from on top of another facizer
Put down a facizer
Stack a facizer on top of another facizer

I have the following restrictions on my actions:
I can only pick up or unstack one facizer at a time.
I can only pick up or unstack a facizer if my hand is empty.
I can only pick up a facizer if the facizer is on the table and the facizer is clear. A facizer is clear if the facizer has no other facizers on top of it and if the facizer is not picked up.
I can only unstack a facizer from on top of another facizer if the facizer I am unstacking was really on top of the other facizer.
I can only unstack a facizer from on top of another facizer if the facizer I am unstacking is clear.
Once I pick up or unstack a facizer, I am holding the facizer.
I can only put down a facizer that I am holding.
I can only stack a facizer on top of another facizer if I am holding the facizer being stacked.
I can only stack a facizer on top of another facizer if the facizer onto which I am stacking the facizer is clear.
Once I put down or stack a facizer, my hand becomes empty.
Once you stack a facizer on top of a second facizer, the second facizer is no longer clear.

[STATEMENT]

My goal is to have that the blue facizer is on top of the red facizer.

What is the plan to achieve my goal? Think through the plan step by step, then use the token '[ACTIONS]' and give the list of the actions in the plan.
